title: Expedition result body
description: The close of an expedition (register row DK1740; spec-delta S1597): `scored` or `void`, with the reasons. The log recomputes what it can: the frames and the cost are its own count; a result is refused if they differ (expedition_result_mismatch), if it is scored with no frame, with the cost over the cap or without the evaluator's own error rate stated (expedition_must_be_void), and an expedition never carries a claim (it is not claimable as a measured result). Signed by the operator; once for each expedition. Chain: none (prev is null).
